dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a light-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between subtle tonal variations on the skin surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple fine, dark-pixel linear marks resembling rake marks across the central and left dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear rake marks visible across the dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent and centrally aligned longitudinal dorsal ridge.
